Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
Malkavian Dementia enables you to take control of a Malkavian "until
your next untap phase." Is the Malkavian therefore untapped as part of
your untap phase before you return it to its original controller? Can
you order your untap phase to apply other effects before returning the
Malkavian to its controller?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emmit Svenson wrote:
> Malkavian Dementia enables you to take control of a Malkavian "until
> your next untap phase." Is the Malkavian therefore untapped as part of
> your untap phase before you return it to its original controller? Can

No. You don't actually untap anything until you're in your untap phase.
By that time, you no longer control the Demented Malk.

> you order your untap phase to apply other effects before returning the
> Malkavian to its controller?

No. It isn't returned "in" your untap phase; you simply cease to have
control once you reach your untap phase.
